primary.title: Resettled in India? Here's how Form 40 can help defer tax on overseas retirement savings until withdrawal
primary.summary: NRIs who become tax residents in India can defer tax on foreign retirement accounts until withdrawal by filing Form 40. This applies to accounts in the US, UK, Canada and Australia, and offers relief from accrual taxation. Details here.
